gloss: designer; architect; engineer who designs something

definitions.explanation: A person who creates the plans or blueprints for something to be built or made — a building, machine, system, or software. Used for architects, mechanical engineers, software architects, and similar roles.

examples.japanese: この{橋|はし}の{設計者|せっけいしゃ}。
{設計者|せっけいしゃ}と{直接|ちょくせつ}{話|はな}せる{機会|きかい}があった。
examples.english: I had a chance to speak directly with the designer.

examples.japanese: {図面|ずめん}には{設計者|せっけいしゃ}の{名前|なまえ}と{日付|ひづけ}が{記載|きさい}されている。
examples.english: The drawing lists the designer's name and the date.

examples.japanese: {有名|ゆうめい}な{設計者|せっけいしゃ}が{手|て}がけた{美術館|びじゅつかん}が、{今月|こんげつ}{開館|かいかん}する。
examples.english: A museum designed by a famous architect opens this month.

notes:
The agent noun from {設計|せっけい} (design) + {者|しゃ} (person). Covers a wide range of design fields from architecture to engineering to software.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜の{設計者|せっけいしゃ}: the designer of ~
- {設計者|せっけいしゃ}の{意図|いと}: the designer's intent
- {建物|たてもの}の{設計者|せっけいしゃ}: the architect of the building
- {機械|きかい}の{設計者|せっけいしゃ}: the designer of the machine
- {設計者|せっけいしゃ}{一覧|いちらん}: list of designers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {建築家|けんちくか}: architect — specifically a professional architect of buildings
- デザイナー: designer — a borrowing; common in fashion, graphic design, and product design contexts
- {技術者|ぎじゅつしゃ}: engineer; technician — broader, refers to anyone with technical expertise
- {考案者|こうあんしゃ}: devisor; person who came up with an idea — emphasizes the conceptual invention rather than detailed design work

USAGE:
{設計者|せっけいしゃ} is the standard technical and legal term for whoever created the design of something. In everyday conversation about buildings, {建築家|けんちくか} is more common; for clothing or web pages, {デザイナー} is typical. {設計者|せっけいしゃ} shines in engineering contexts and on official documents.
